rule_basis.rule: A raw module may expose a mutable codec model under a non-owner noun; it is not a Package/projection owner or a format staging Edit.
DOC and XLS raw::Reader methods are cursor-backed codec reads/outputs; they are not reachable through the immutable Package owner.
The ODB and ODG litchi_core::SubEdit aliases are composition values; package publication remains on the format route.
NestedFieldEdit is a Copy borrowed wire descriptor consumed by a bounded raw function and has no package/staging/commit lifecycle.
EntryEdit is a Copy borrowed archive descriptor consumed by bounded physical reassembly and has no package/staging/commit lifecycle.

raw_reader_groups.definition_role: The model documentation calls Reader a cursor-backed low-level mutable codec reader and identifies Package as the immutable owner. The public raw module reexports that Reader; it does not reexport Package as a mutable projection.
raw_reader_groups.lifecycle_absence: Every listed method reads/seeks the underlying OleFile, copies source bytes, or emits a typed raw projection. No method returns a package Commit/Patch/Diagnostics triad or stages an Edit; package publication is implemented by litchi_doc::Package elsewhere.
